set.body:
Outcome

Move all current representational analyses to PartitionedRelations or explicitly typed observation/effect sources.

Acceptance

- Pair domains and estimand metadata remain authoritative in every result.
- Operator receipts are preserved rather than projected to scalar strings.
- Samplewise and feature-model analyses declare their actual scientific axes instead of accepting irrelevant Response values.
- Old RoiPayload RDM and RSA cases are removed.
set.title: P5.3: migrate dense and operator RDM, RSA, samplewise RSA, and feature models
